about: The daily proof ladder's settings (proof-ladder.yml reads them; change them by a commit). maxItems: items checked a day at most (the Worker allows the owner's bench 2,500 and all accounts 3,000 checks a day, so this leaves the app most of the day). share: dollars a month of the cloud checker's cap (CLAUDE_MONTHLY_USD, 40) the ladder may use, spread evenly over the month; the rest stays for the owner's own checks (27 of 40 keeps about the split it had at 60 of 90, before the owner moved 30, then 20 more, to Opus jobs on 16 Oct). all: false checks only questions the source proof can read (no other can reach Verified today); true once the vignette route is live. hours: how long one day's run may take. runnerSeats: how many runner voters' answers go with each batch (the Worker seats at most RUNNER_SEATS of them); raise it only once the ledger on the progress page shows the runners answer as well as the live families. runnerBar: a runner's answers go with a batch only once its own blind answers are at least this right by the 95% lower bound, on 200 or more (day one: the faster runner was 56% right, so it held a seat it had not earned). poolBatches: batches a day the Workers AI voters may answer for the ladder, about half the day's free pool, since the owner's bench is not held to an account's share.
